name: smoothed bigram probabilities
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=2, alpha=1.0).train("ababa")
assert math.isclose(model.prob("a", "b"), 0.75, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isclose(model.prob("a", "a"), 0.25, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isclose(model.prob("z", "a"), 0.5, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert model.prob("a", "z") == 0.0

name: unigram probabilities and perplexity
test:
import math
model = NGramCharModel(n=1, alpha=1.0).train("aab")
assert math.isclose(model.prob("ignored", "a"), 0.6, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isclose(model.prob("ignored", "b"), 0.4, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isclose(model.perplexity("ab"), 2.041241452319315, rel_tol=1e-9)
assert math.isinf(model.perplexity(""))

name: train resets previous state
test:
model = NGramCharModel(n=2, alpha=1.0)
model.train("aaaa")
assert model.prob("a", "a") == 1.0
model.train("bb")
assert model.prob("b", "b") == 1.0
assert model.prob("a", "a") == 0.0
assert model.prob("a", "b") == 1.0

name: seeded top-k sampling excludes lower-ranked characters
test:
import random
model = NGramCharModel(n=1, alpha=1.0).train("aaabbc")
random.seed(7)
samples = [model.sample_top_k("", k=2) for _ in range(300)]
assert set(samples) <= {"a", "b"}
a_frequency = samples.count("a") / len(samples)
assert 0.50 < a_frequency < 0.68

name: k larger than vocabulary samples from all known characters
invalid arguments raise ValueError
input: n = 0, alpha = 0, empty train text, k = 0
test:
def expect_value_error(callable_obj):
    try:
        callable_obj()
    except ValueError:
        return
    raise AssertionError("expected ValueError")

expect_value_error(lambda: NGramCharModel(n=0))
expect_value_error(lambda: NGramCharModel(alpha=0))
model = NGramCharModel()
expect_value_error(lambda: model.train(""))
model.train("abc")
expect_value_error(lambda: model.sample_top_k("", k=0))
